	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Total"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_cliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Imprime"
		*thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".NumPrioridad"
		*thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".NumeroOperacion"
		
		
		*!*	thisform.oCmdDetalle.Enabled=!thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsTablaVacia()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		thisform.tg_grid2.visible = .f.
		
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Sumar("iif(Suma,1,-1)*Total",".t."),2)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionar
		Local vDatos[1,2],lImprime
		
		If Alltrim(Upper(ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption))="NINGUNO"
			lImprime = .f.
		Else
			lImprime = .t.
		Endif
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Imprime",lImprime)
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EnDDo
		
		If lImprime 
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Ninguno"
		Else
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Seleccionar todo"
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE traerultimacotizacion
		LParameters cId_Moneda
		Local dFechaMayor, nCotizacion
		
		nCotizacion = 1
		
		if thisform.oTblCotizaciones.Buscar(cId_Moneda, .f., "CLAVE")
			dFechaMayor = thisform.oTblCotizaciones.Leer("Fecha")
			nCotizacion = thisform.oTblCotizaciones.Leer("Cotizacion")
		
			do while !thisform.oTblCotizaciones.EsEof() and thisform.oTblCotizaciones.Leer("Id_Moneda") = cId_Moneda
				if thisform.oTblCotizaciones.Leer("Fecha") > dFechaMayor
					dFechaMayor = thisform.oTblCotizaciones.Leer("Fecha")
					nCotizacion = thisform.oTblCotizaciones.Leer("Cotizacion")
				endif
				thisform.oTblCotizaciones.IrSiguiente()
			enddo
		
		endif
		
		return nCotizacion
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cmd_imputacion.Click
		Local cid_sucursal,cid_sistema,cid_comproba,nnro_referencia
		
		cid_sucursal = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("id_sucursal")
		cid_sistema = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("id_sistema")
		cid_comproba = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("id_comproba")
		nnro_referencia = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("nro_referencia")
		
		if type("thisform.oImputacionComprobante")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oImputacionComprobante","TG_ConsultaImputacion")
		
		Endif
		thisform.oImputacionComprobante.SetearConsulta(cid_sucursal,cId_sistema,cid_comproba,nnro_referencia)
		thisform.oImputacionComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		****this.Enabled=.f.
		
		****thisform.tg_CommandButton1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		thisform.cmd_imputacion.enabled = .t.
		thisform.tg_grid2.visible = .f.
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdSeleccionar.Click
		Thisform.Seleccionar()
		
		thisform.tg_grid2.visible = .f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxClienteDesde.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde=this.Value
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value=this.Value
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxClienteHasta.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
			***ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
			***ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxNumero.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldNumero
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldNumero=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxReferencia.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldReferencia
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldReferencia=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local cid_sucursal,cid_sistema,cid_comproba,nnro_referencia
		
		******* Diego 09-06-09
		Local cid_com_bas,nnro_bas, cid_suc_bas,cid_sis_bas
		******* Diego 09-06-09
		
		
		**BPT
		*!*		thisform.otblVnt_Cabecera.SetearProp("BOT")
		*!*		thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.SetearProp("BOT")
		*!*		thisform.oVnt_Detalle.SetearProp("BOT")
		*!*		thisform.oVnt_Ivas.SetearProp("BOT")
		*!*		thisform.oTblCotizaciones.SetearProp("BOT")
		*!*		thisform.oVnt_Numeracion.SetearProp("BOT")
		*!*		thisform.oVnt_Ivas.SetearProp("BOT")
		*!*		thisform.oTblVnt_Vencimientos.SetearProp("BOT")
		*!*		thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.SetearProp("BOT")
		
		
		
		cid_sucursal = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("id_sucursal")
		cid_sistema = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("id_sistema")
		cid_comproba = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("id_comproba")
		nnro_referencia = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("nro_referencia")
		
		
		**********Thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Imputacion"		,"tg_tabla","Vnt_Imputacion","Clave")
		*!*	if type("thisform.oImputacionComprobante")<>T_OBJECT
		*!*		thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oImputacionComprobante","TG_ConsultaImputacion")
		
		*!*	Endif
		*!*	thisform.oImputacionComprobante.SetearConsulta(cid_sucursal,cId_sistema,cid_comproba,nnro_referencia)
		*!*	thisform.oImputacionComprobante.Show()
		
		thisform.oAux_Mayor.Irprimero()
		Do While Not thisform.oAux_Mayor.EsEof()
			
			thisform.oAux_Mayor.Borrar()
			thisform.oAux_Mayor.IrSiguiente()
		EnDDo
		
		
		
		
		If thisform.oVnt_imputacion.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_comproba+str(nNro_Referencia,10))
		
		
		
			Do while Thisform.oVnt_imputacion.EsClaveIgual()
			
				if !thisform.oVnt_imputacion.Leer("Pendiente")
				    ***ow (thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Com_Cruce")+ Str(thisform.oVnt_imputacion.Leer("Nro_Cruce"),10))
				    
		  	  		if thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(cid_Sucursal+"V"+thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Com_Cruce")+ Str(thisform.oVnt_imputacion.Leer("Nro_Cruce"),10))
		  	  		
			  	  		cid_com_bas = Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_com_bas")
						nnro_bas    = Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("nro_bas")
						cid_suc_bas = Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_suc_bas")
						cid_sis_bas = Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_sis_bas")
						if thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(cid_suc_bas+cid_sis_bas+cid_com_bas+str(nnro_bas,10))
						 	 *****wait window (thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba")+ Str(thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Nro_referencia"),10))
		
						 	 thisform.PagosPublicidad_simul(cid_suc_bas,cid_sis_bas,cid_com_bas,nnro_bas)     
		 			 	 Endif
			 
		 			 thisform.mostrarprorrateo 	 
		 		
		 		Endif	 
		 		
		 	    Endif	
					 	 
				thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.IrSiguiente		
			Enddo
			
		
		
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
				ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled=.F.
				ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=.F.
				ThisForm.oCmdAvanzado.Enabled=.F.
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_prorrateo.Click
		Local cid_sucursal,cid_sistema,cid_comproba,nnro_referencia
		Local vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		******* Diego 09-06-09
		Local cid_com_bas,nnro_bas, cid_suc_bas,cid_sis_bas
		******* Diego 09-06-09
		
		*!*			thisform.otblVnt_Cabecera.SetearProp("BD")
		*!*			thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.SetearProp("BD")
		*!*			thisform.oVnt_Detalle.SetearProp("BD")
		*!*			thisform.oVnt_Ivas.SetearProp("BD")
		*!*			thisform.oTblCotizaciones.SetearProp("BD")
		*!*			thisform.oVnt_Numeracion.SetearProp("BD")
		*!*			thisform.oVnt_Ivas.SetearProp("BD")
		*!*			thisform.oTblVnt_Vencimientos.SetearProp("BD")
		*!*			thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.SetearProp("BD")
		
		
		
		cid_sucursal = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("id_sucursal")
		cid_sistema = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("id_sistema")
		cid_comproba = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("id_comproba")
		nnro_referencia = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("nro_referencia")
		
		
		**********Thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Imputacion"		,"tg_tabla","Vnt_Imputacion","Clave")
		*!*	if type("thisform.oImputacionComprobante")<>T_OBJECT
		*!*		thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oImputacionComprobante","TG_ConsultaImputacion")
		
		*!*	Endif
		*!*	thisform.oImputacionComprobante.SetearConsulta(cid_sucursal,cId_sistema,cid_comproba,nnro_referencia)
		*!*	thisform.oImputacionComprobante.Show()
		
		
		
		If thisform.oVnt_imputacion.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_comproba+str(nNro_Referencia,10))
		
		
		
			Do while Thisform.oVnt_imputacion.EsClaveIgual()
			
				if !thisform.oVnt_imputacion.Leer("Pendiente")
				    ***wait window (thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Com_Cruce")+ Str(thisform.oVnt_imputacion.Leer("Nro_Cruce"),10))
				    
		  	  		if thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(cid_Sucursal+"V"+thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Com_Cruce")+ Str(thisform.oVnt_imputacion.Leer("Nro_Cruce"),10))
		  	  		
			  	  		cid_com_bas = Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_com_bas")
						nnro_bas    = Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("nro_bas")
						cid_suc_bas = Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_suc_bas")
						cid_sis_bas = Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_sis_bas")
						if thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(cid_suc_bas+cid_sis_bas+cid_com_bas+str(nnro_bas,10))
						 	 *****wait window (thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba")+ Str(thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Nro_referencia"),10))
		                   	oApp.ComenzarTransaccion(thisform.DataSessionId)				 	 
						 	 thisform.PagosPublicidad(cid_suc_bas,cid_sis_bas,cid_com_bas,nnro_bas)     
						 	 if thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(cid_Sucursal+cid_sistema+cid_comproba+ Str(nnro_referencia,10))				 	 
					  	  		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"pendiente_prorrateo"		,.f.)
								thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
		  		  	  		Endif
		
						 	 
						 	 
					 	 	oApp.FinalizarTransaccion(thisform.DataSessionId)
							If Type("ThisForm.oFrmProrrateopagos")<>T_OBJECT
									ThisForm.CrearYAsignarObjeto("ThisForm.oFrmConsultasProrrateopagos","Tg_ConsProrrateopagos")				
							EndIf
								ThisForm.oFrmConsultasProrrateopagos.MostrarMovimientos(cid_suc_bas,cid_sis_bas,cid_com_bas,nnro_bas)
								ThisForm.oFrmConsultasProrrateopagos.Show()
		 			 	 Endif
					 	 
				 Endif	  
				Endif		
				thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.IrSiguiente		
			Enddo
		
		Endif	
		
		
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE buscarymostrarpagos
		lParameter cId_Proveedor, cRazon_Social, nImporte, cSuc_Prof, cSis_Prof, cCom_Prof, nRef_Prof
		Local vGrabacion, nSaldo
		 
		** Titulo dinámico con los datos de la proforma
		ThisForm.TituloConsulta(cId_Proveedor, cRazon_Social, nImporte)
		
		** Cargo los pagos asociados al provedor en una tabla auxiliar
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		nSaldo=0.00
		
		ThisForm.oAux_PagosProforma.Revertir()
		
		ThisForm.oPagosSocios.IrPrimero()
		Do While !ThisForm.oPagosSocios.EsEof()
			If ThisForm.oPagosSocios.Leer("Id_Sucursal_Prof")=cSuc_Prof.And.ThisForm.oPagosSocios.Leer("Id_Sistema_Prof")=cSis_Prof.And.ThisForm.oPagosSocios.Leer("Id_Comproba_Prof")=cCom_Prof.And.ThisForm.oPagosSocios.Leer("Nro_Referencia_Prof")=nRef_Prof
				nSaldo=nSaldo+ThisForm.oPagosSocios.Leer("Importe")*ThisForm.oPagosSocios.Leer("Porc_Publicidad_Provee")/100
			
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha"					,ThisForm.oPagosSocios.Leer("Fecha_Pago"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Orden"					,ThisForm.oPagosSocios.Leer("Orden"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Importe"					,ThisForm.oPagosSocios.Leer("Importe"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Porc_Publicidad_Provee"	,ThisForm.oPagosSocios.Leer("Porc_Publicidad_Provee"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Importe_Publicidad"		,ThisForm.oPagosSocios.Leer("Importe")*ThisForm.oPagosSocios.Leer("Porc_Publicidad_Provee")/100)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Saldo"					,nSaldo)
				
				ThisForm.oAux_PagosProforma.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.T.)		
			EndIf
			
			ThisForm.oPagosSocios.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		**
		
		ThisForm.oAux_PagosProforma.IrPrimero()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargargrilla
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid2.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.tg_Grid2.RecordSource=ThisForm.oAux_PagosProforma.Alias
		
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid2.Column1.ControlSource=ThisForm.oAux_PagosProforma.Alias+".Fecha"
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid2.Column2.ControlSource=ThisForm.oAux_PagosProforma.Alias+".Orden"
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid2.Column3.ControlSource=ThisForm.oAux_PagosProforma.Alias+".Importe"
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid2.Column4.ControlSource=ThisForm.oAux_PagosProforma.Alias+".Porc_Publicidad_Provee"
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid2.Column5.ControlSource=ThisForm.oAux_PagosProforma.Alias+".Importe_Publicidad"
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid2.Column6.ControlSource=ThisForm.oAux_PagosProforma.Alias+".Saldo"
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid2.Column7.ControlSource=ThisForm.oAux_PagosProforma.Alias+".Id_Socio"
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid2.Column8.ControlSource=ThisForm.oAux_PagosProforma.Alias+".Razon_Social_Socio"
		*** Diego 13-09-2010
		ThisForm.oAux_PagosProforma.Irprimero()
		*** Diego 13-09-2010
		ThisForm.Refresh()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE consultarpagos
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DoDefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblRelacionProrrateo","Tg_Tabla","RelacionProrrateo")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewRelacionProrrateo","Tg_ViewRelacionProrrateo")
		
		*********************
		this.AddObject("oTblVnt_Cabecerabas", "Tg_Tabla", "Vnt_Cabecera", "CLAVE")
		****ThisForm.CargarGrilla()
		
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid2.ResaltarRenglon()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobantes
		*If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobantenc")<>T_OBJECT			 *
		*	thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobantenc","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Leer("Id_Comprobanc"),thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Leer("Nro_Referencianc"),thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Leer("Id_sucursalnc"),thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Leer("Id_Sistemanc"),.t.)				
		*	thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobantenc.Show()
		*Else
		*	Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobantenc.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Leer("Id_Comprobanc"),thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Leer("Nro_Referencianc"),thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Leer("Id_sucursalnc"),thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Leer("Id_Sistemanc"),.t.)			
		*Endif	
		
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobantenc")<>"O"
		 	thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobantenc","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Leer("Id_Comprobanc"),thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Leer("Nro_Referencianc"),thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Leer("Id_sucursalnc"),thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Leer("Id_Sistemanc"),.t.)				
		endif 	
		Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobantenc.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Leer("Id_Comprobanc"),thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Leer("Nro_Referencianc"),thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Leer("Id_sucursalnc"),thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Leer("Id_Sistemanc"),.t.)			
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobantenc.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmovimientos
		lParameters cid_sucursal,cid_sistema,cid_comproba,nnro_referencia
		 
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta(cid_sucursal,cid_sistema,cid_comproba,nnro_referencia)
		
		*****thisform.tg_grid2.RecordSource=""
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters cid_sucursal,cid_sistema,cid_comproba,nnro_referencia
		******* Diego 20-05-2010
		Local cid_com_bas,nnro_bas, cid_suc_bas,cid_sis_bas
		******* Diego 20-05-2010
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.tg_grid2.RecordSource=""
		***this.AddObject("oTblVnt_Cabecerabas", "Tg_Tabla", "Vnt_Cabecera", "CLAVE")
		*cid_com_bas = Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecerabas.Leer("id_com_bas")
		*nnro_bas    = Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecerabas.Leer("nro_bas")
		*cid_suc_bas = Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecerabas.Leer("id_suc_bas")
		*cid_sis_bas = Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecerabas.Leer("id_sis_bas")
						
		if thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecerabas.Buscar(cid_sucursal+cid_sistema+cid_comproba+str(nnro_referencia,10))
				thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Refrescar(Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecerabas.Leer("id_suc_bas"),Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecerabas.Leer("id_sis_bas"),Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecerabas.Leer("id_com_bas"),Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecerabas.Leer("nro_bas"))
				thisform.tg_grid2.RecordSource=thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Alias
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Alias+".Id_Comprobanc"
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Alias+".Nro_Referencianc"
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Alias+".Importe"
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Alias+".Nombre"
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.Alias+".Id_Cliente"
		
				thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.IrPrimero
		endif		
		thisform.oViewRelacionProrrateo.IrPrimero
		thisform.tg_grid2.Refresh
		ThisForm.Refresh()
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE tituloconsulta
		lParameter cId_Proveedor, cRazon_Social, nImporte
		
		ThisForm.Caption="Fecha: "+Dtoc(Date())+"     Proveedor: ("+cId_Proveedor+") "+cRazon_Social+" $"+Str(nImporte,10,2)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btncancelar1.Click
		ThisForm.Hide()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btncancelar2.Click
		ThisForm.Cancelar()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid2.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobantes
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="form" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	ADD OBJECT 'oCmdCambioUsuario' AS tg_commandbutton WITH ;

		Caption = "Pagos Locales de Socios", ;
		Height = 19, ;
		Left = 12, ;
		Name = "oCmdPagosSocios", ;
		TabIndex = 1, ;
		Top = 12, ;
		Width = 180
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="commandbutton" />
	
	PROCEDURE Activate
		If Empty(ThisForm.oFrmIniciarSesion.Id_socio)
			ThisForm.Salir()
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE iniciarsesion
		ThisForm.oFrmIniciarSesion = 3
		ThisForm.CrearYAsignarObjeto("ThisForm.oFrmIniciarSesion","tg_IniciarSesionUsuConsola")
		ThisForm.oFrmIniciarSesion.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DoDefault()
		
		ThisForm.AddProperty("oFrmIniciarSesion", 3)
		ThisForm.AddProperty("oFrmPagosSocios", 3)
		ThisForm.AddProperty("oFrmPagosARetirar", 3)
		
		ThisForm.IniciarSesion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE salir
		Thisform.Release()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCambioUsuario.Click
		ThisForm.IniciarSesion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCerrar.Click
		Thisform.Salir()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdPagosARetirar.Click
		ThisForm.oFrmPagosARetirar=3
		ThisForm.oFrmPagosARetirar=CreateObject("Tg_CargaPagosARetirarDelGrupo",ThisForm.oFrmIniciarSesion.Id_socio)
		ThisForm.oFrmPagosARetirar.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdPagosSocios.Click
		ThisForm.oFrmPagosSocios=3
		ThisForm.oFrmPagosSocios=CreateObject("Tg_CargaPagosDeSocios",.T.,ThisForm.oFrmIniciarSesion.Id_socio)
		ThisForm.oFrmPagosSocios.Show()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

		ThisForm.Hide()

	PROCEDURE oCmdIniciarSesion.Click
		if ThisForm.oTblUsuConsola.Buscar(ThisForm.oCmbUsuConsola.Value,.f.,"Id_usuario")
			if alltrim(uppe(ThisForm.oTblUsuConsola.Leer("Clave")))==alltrim(upper(ThisForm.oTbxClave.Value))
				thisform.id_socio=ThisForm.oTblUsuConsola.Leer("Id_socio")
				thisform.hide()
			else
				=fMensAceptar("El usuario no coincide con la contraseña")
			endif
		else
			=fMensAceptar("Error en el usuario")
		endif
	ENDPROC

		Left = 120, ;
		Name = "Tg_textbox5", ;
		TabIndex = 16, ;
		Top = 156
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_textbox6' AS tg_textbox WITH ;
		Left = 120, ;
		Name = "Tg_textbox6", ;
		TabIndex = 18, ;
		Top = 180
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_textbox7' AS tg_textbox WITH ;
		Format = "9999-99999999", ;
		InputMask = "9999-99999999", ;
		Left = 120, ;
		Name = "Tg_textbox7", ;
		TabIndex = 20, ;
		Top = 204
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />
	
	PROCEDURE grabarmodificaciones
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		If ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Buscar(ThisForm.Orden)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Socio"					,ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Razon_Social_Socio"		,ThisForm.Tg_label9.caption)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Proveedor"				,ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Razon_Social"				,ThisForm.Tg_label10.caption)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Factura"				,ThisForm.Tg_textbox3.value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Pago"				,ThisForm.Tg_textbox4.value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"TuvoDescuento"			,ThisForm.Tg_checkbox1.value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"CancelaTotal"				,ThisForm.Tg_checkbox2.value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Recibido"			,ThisForm.Tg_textbox5.value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Entregado"			,ThisForm.Tg_textbox6.value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Recibo"				,ThisForm.Tg_textbox7.value)
			
			ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.T.,.T.)
			
			=fMensAceptar("Las modificaciones fueron grabadas correctamente")
		EndIf
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DoDefault()
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblClientes","Tg_tabla","Clientes","Clave")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblPagosSocios","Tg_tabla","PagosSocios","Clave")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblConfigCategoriasPagosLocales","Tg_tabla","ConfigCategoriasPagosLocales","Clave")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearvaloresinicio
		lParameters nOrden
		
		ThisForm.Orden=nOrden
		
		If ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Buscar(ThisForm.Orden)
			ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.value			=ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Leer("Id_Socio")
			ThisForm.Tg_label9.caption			=AllTrim(ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Leer("Razon_Social_Socio"))
			ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.value			=ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Leer("Id_Proveedor")
			ThisForm.Tg_label10.caption			=AllTrim(ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Leer("Razon_Social"))
			ThisForm.Tg_textbox3.value			=ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Leer("Nro_Factura")
			ThisForm.Tg_textbox4.value			=ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Leer("Fecha_Pago")
			ThisForm.Tg_checkbox1.value			=ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Leer("TuvoDescuento")
			ThisForm.Tg_checkbox2.value			=ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Leer("CancelaTotal")
			ThisForm.Tg_textbox5.value			=ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Leer("Fecha_Recibido")
			ThisForm.Tg_textbox6.value			=ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Leer("Fecha_Entregado")
			ThisForm.Tg_textbox7.value			=ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Leer("Nro_Recibo")
				
			ThisForm.Id_Categoria_Socios		=ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Leer("Id_Categoria_Socios")
			ThisForm.Id_Categoria_Proveedores	=ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Leer("Id_Categoria_Proveedores")
		EndIf
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validardatos
		lParameter lNoMostrarMensajes
		Local lEsValido
		
		lEsValido=.T.
		
		* Que el socio no quede vacío
		If Empty(ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value).And.lEsValido
			If !lNoMostrarMensajes
				=fMensAceptar("No puede quedar vacío el campo del Socio")
			EndIf
			lEsValido=.F.
		EndIf
		
		* Que el proveedor no quede vacío
		If Empty(ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.Value).And.lEsValido
			If !lNoMostrarMensajes
				=fMensAceptar("No puede quedar vacío el campo del Proveedor")
			EndIf
			lEsValido=.F.
		EndIf
					
		* Que el Número de Factura no esté vacío
		If lEsValido
			If AllTrim(ThisForm.Tg_textbox3.value)="-"
				If !lNoMostrarMensajes
					=fMensAceptar("No puede quedar vacío el número de Factura")
				EndIf
				lEsValido=.F.
			Else
				* Que esten completos los 12 digitos del numero de fatura
				If Len(AllTrim(StrTran(ThisForm.Tg_textbox3.value," ","")))<13
					If !lNoMostrarMensajes
						=fMensAceptar("Debe completar los 12 dígitos del número de Factura")
					EndIf
					lEsValido=.F.
				EndIf
			EndIf
		EndIf
		
		* Que la fecha del Pago no quede vacía
		If Empty(ThisForm.Tg_textbox4.value).And.lEsValido
			If !lNoMostrarMensajes
				=fMensAceptar("No puede quedar vacía la fecha de Pago")
			EndIf
			lEsValido=.F.
		EndIf
		
		* Que la fecha de Entrega no este completa si la fecha de Recibo está vacía
		If Empty(ThisForm.Tg_textbox5.value).And.!Empty(ThisForm.Tg_textbox6.value).And.lEsValido
			If !lNoMostrarMensajes
				=fMensAceptar("No puede haber Fecha Entregado si no hay Fecha Recibido")
			EndIf
			lEsValido=.F.
		EndIf
		
		Return lEsValido
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validarfacturaanteriorcancelatotalmente
		Local lEsValido, cLocCancelaAnt, cLocAlgoPos, cId_Soc, cId_Pro, cN_Fac, dFePago
		
		lEsValido	=.T.
		cId_Soc		=ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value
		cId_Pro		=ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.Value
		cN_Fac		=AllTrim(ThisForm.Tg_textbox3.value)
		dFePago		=ThisForm.Tg_textbox4.value
		
		If cN_Fac!="9999-99999999" && Si el numero de factura es 9999-99999999 no valido que ya haya otra factura con el mismo numero. Es valido
		
			cLocCancelaAnt	="Id_Socio+Id_Proveedor+AllTrim(Nro_Factura)+IIf(CancelaTotal,'S','N')+IIf(Fecha_Pago<ctod('"+dtoc(dFePago)+"').Or.(Fecha_Pago=ctod('"+dtoc(dFePago)+"').And.(Orden<"+Str(ThisForm.Orden)+")),'S','N')='"+cId_Soc+cId_Pro+cN_Fac+"SS'"
			cLocAlgoPos		="Id_Socio+Id_Proveedor+AllTrim(Nro_Factura)+IIf(Fecha_Pago>ctod('"+dtoc(dFePago)+"').Or.(Fecha_Pago=ctod('"+dtoc(dFePago)+"').And.Orden>"+Str(ThisForm.Orden)+"),'S','N')='"+cId_Soc+cId_Pro+cN_Fac+"S'"
		
			* Localizo si hay un pago que cancela totalmente antes
			ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.IrPrimero()
			If ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Localizar(cLocCancelaAnt)
				lEsValido=.F.
				=fMensAceptar("La Factura "+cN_Fac+" del Proveedor "+cId_Pro+", Socio "+cId_Soc+Chr(13)+"fue cancelada anteriormente."+Chr(13)+"Orden: "+AllTrim(Str(ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Leer("Orden"))))
			EndIf
		
			* Localizo si hay un pago posterior a este (si este cancela total)
			ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.IrPrimero()
			If lEsValido.And.ThisForm.Tg_checkbox2.Value.And.ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Localizar(cLocAlgoPos)
				lEsValido=.F.
				=fMensAceptar("La Factura "+cN_Fac+" del Proveedor "+cId_Pro+", Socio "+cId_Soc+Chr(13)+"tiene un pago cargado posteriormente."+Chr(13)+"Orden: "+AllTrim(Str(ThisForm.oTblPagosSocios.Leer("Orden"))))
			EndIf
			
		EndIf && Fin cNro_Factura
		
		Return lEsValido
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar1.Click
		If ThisForm.ValidarDatos().And.ThisForm.ValidarFacturaAnteriorCancelaTotalmente()
			If fMensPregunto("Se grabaran las modificaciones realizadas en al Pago Asociado a una Proforma."+Chr(13)+"¿Desea continuar?","N",.F.)="S"
				ThisForm.GrabarModificaciones()
				ThisForm.Hide()
			EndIf
		EndIf
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btncancelar2.Click
		ThisForm.Hide()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.RightClick
		Local cFiltroCategoria
		
		* LUCHO M. 29-10-09
		cFiltroCategoria="InList(Id_Categoria"
		ThisForm.oTblConfigCategoriasPagosLocales.IrPrimero()
		Do While !ThisForm.oTblConfigCategoriasPagosLocales.EsEof()
			If ThisForm.oTblConfigCategoriasPagosLocales.Leer("EsSocio")
				cFiltroCategoria=cFiltroCategoria+",'"+ThisForm.oTblConfigCategoriasPagosLocales.Leer("Id_Categoria")+"'"
			EndIf
			ThisForm.oTblConfigCategoriasPagosLocales.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		cFiltroCategoria=cFiltroCategoria+",'"+ThisForm.Id_Categoria_Socios+"')"
		DoDefault(cFiltroCategoria)
		* LUCHO M. 29-10-09
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.Valid
		Local lRetorna,cRazon_SocialOld
		
		lRetorna=.T.
		cRazon_SocialOld=ThisForm.Tg_label9.Caption
		
		If ThisForm.oTblClientes.Buscar(This.Value)
			* LUCHO M. 29-10-09
			cFiltroCategoria="!InList('"+ThisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Categoria")+"'"
			ThisForm.oTblConfigCategoriasPagosLocales.IrPrimero()
			Do While !ThisForm.oTblConfigCategoriasPagosLocales.EsEof()
				If ThisForm.oTblConfigCategoriasPagosLocales.Leer("EsSocio")
					cFiltroCategoria=cFiltroCategoria+",'"+ThisForm.oTblConfigCategoriasPagosLocales.Leer("Id_Categoria")+"'"
				EndIf
				ThisForm.oTblConfigCategoriasPagosLocales.IrSiguiente()
			EndDo
			
			cFiltroCategoria=cFiltroCategoria+",'"+ThisForm.Id_Categoria_Socios+"')"
			If &cFiltroCategoria
				lRetorna=.F.
			EndIf
			* LUCHO M. 29-10-09
		Else
			lRetorna=.F.
		EndIf
		
		If lRetorna
			ThisForm.Tg_label9.Caption=ThisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")
		Else
			ThisForm.Tg_label9.Caption=cRazon_SocialOld
		EndIf
		
		** PARA HACER MAS DINAMICA LA GRILLA - Es vacío el ID lo dejo seguir "Igualmente lo valido al grabar"
		If Empty(This.Value)
			ThisForm.Tg_label9.Caption=""
			lRetorna=.T.
		EndIf
		*****
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="form" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_commandbutton2" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_btncancelar2" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*m: modificarpagoasociadaaproforma

		*m: setearvalores
		*p: ofrmconsultasproforma
		*p: ofrmmodificarpagoasociadoaproforma
		*p: orden
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		Caption = "Opciones de Pago Asociado a Proforma"
		DataSession = 2
		DoCreate = .T.
		Height = 95
		LockScreen = .F.
		Name = "tg_opcionesproforma"

		WindowState = 0
		Tg_timerBase.Left = 0
		Tg_timerBase.Name = "Tg_timerBase"
		Tg_timerBase.Top = 72
		Mwresize1.lblHighLight.Name = "lblHighLight"
		Mwresize1.lblShading.Name = "lblShading"
		Mwresize1.Name = "Mwresize1"
	*</PropValue>

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_3dshape1' AS tg_3dshape WITH ;

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_btncancelar2' AS tg_btncancelar WITH ;

		Caption = "Consultar Proforma asociada al Pago", ;

		Left = 12, ;

		Top = 12, ;
		Width = 336
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="commandbutton" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_commandbutton2' AS tg_commandbutton WITH ;
		Caption = "Modificar el Pago asociado a la Proforma", ;
		Height = 19, ;
		Left = 12, ;
		Name = "Tg_commandbutton2", ;
		Top = 36, ;
		Width = 336
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="commandbutton" />
	
	PROCEDURE Init
		DoDefault()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE modificarpagoasociadaaproforma
		If Type("ThisForm.oFrmModificarPagoAsociadoAProforma")<>T_OBJECT
			ThisForm.CrearYAsignarObjeto("ThisForm.oFrmModificarPagoAsociadoAProforma","Tg_ModificarPagoAsociadoAProforma")				
		EndIf
		
		ThisForm.oFrmModificarPagoAsociadoAProforma.SetearValoresInicio(ThisForm.Orden)
		ThisForm.oFrmModificarPagoAsociadoAProforma.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarproformaasociada
		If Type("ThisForm.oFrmConsultasProforma")<>T_OBJECT
			ThisForm.CrearYAsignarObjeto("ThisForm.oFrmConsultasProforma","Tg_ConsProforma")				
		EndIf
		
		ThisForm.oFrmConsultasProforma.ConsultarProforma(ThisForm.Orden)
		ThisForm.oFrmConsultasProforma.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearvalores
		lParameters nOrden
		
		ThisForm.Orden=nOrden
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btncancelar2.Click
		ThisForm.Hide()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		ThisForm.MostrarProformaAsociada()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		ThisForm.ModificarPagoAsociadaAProforma()
	ENDPROC
